summary: Santa Barbara County cabin lookout on West Big Pine Mountain, built 1934 on a 10-foot timber tower; removal date unknown; a 2018 hiker found footings and scattered metal.

facts.design: California Region 5 Plan BC-301 cabin on a 10-foot open timber tower
facts.status_note: Removal date unknown; a 2018 blog post describes only a couple of footings and scattered metal

staffing.status: staffed 24 hours a day after an Aircraft Warning System residence cabin was added during WWII

notes_for_editor: Only three sources, and the 1934 build date and the WWII cabin rest on the register alone. The 2018 blog is the only source on the site today; it is a personal account, not a survey. The Forest Lookouts page gives location only. A search snippet (not fetched) cites a 1955 Refugio Fire history (ResearchGate PDF) that names West Big Pine among lookouts to get radio telephones; its text is garbled and was not used. The same snippet says the forest was called Santa Barbara National Forest until December 3, 1936; not verified. The register lists the site as US 2017, CA 134. firelookout.org's CA index shows an NHLR US 1060 near West Big Pine; not checked. No closure or access notice was found, so no access level is recorded. The 2018 blog says the lookout stands on a peak it calls West Big Pine Lookout, and that the higher peak to the east is 'properly' West Big Pine Mountain; the register places the lookout on West Big Pine Mountain, so the story keeps the register's identification and reports the blogger's view.
